product: Elevate Souls Productions Content Creation Command Center

scale_gates.reason: Current application durability is SQLite-path based; multi-host writers are unsafe until full PostgreSQL parity is implemented and tested.
Creative assets currently rely on project/host storage paths; distributed workers need authorized object-storage-backed assets.
Horizontal worker/GPU scaling requires durable shared queue semantics and idempotent job ownership.
A real ESP GPU host must load the approved local model, answer Aura chat, execute structured tool-routing tests and survive restart/failover before production inference is claimed live.
The ESP-owned Harbor registry, replication/backup, vulnerability policy and retention model must be provisioned and restore-tested before it becomes the production registry.
Production Kubernetes promotion must reject unsigned/unapproved container images and require exact immutable digests.
OpenBao or the reviewed equivalent must run in HA mode with audited policies, backup/recovery and least-privilege Kubernetes authentication before replacing deployment secret files.
PostgreSQL PITR, object storage, registry, secrets/configuration and application backups must be restored successfully in a drill.
Pod/node loss, payment/provider connectivity, email, storage and live AI generation require staging E2E evidence.
